task.description: WF-03 Step 5 (Verify) for ISS-0107 / GitHub #366, after 2 rounds of design rework. BACKEND-DEV's final implementation (tests/integration/helpers.zig) widens the bpm_test_migrations_public advisory-lock scope to cover resetTestData()/applyCompatibilityShims() AND scopes lock_timeout to 90s around just the widened acquire (restored to 5s immediately after). Across 2 full zig build test-integration runs, BACKEND-DEV confirmed: zero 40P01 deadlocks, zero 55P03 lock-timeout-cancellations at the widened acquire specifically (1 unrelated 55P03 elsewhere in each run, in sch02_timer_polling_test.zig, not connected to this fix). Pass counts: run1 544 passed/92 failed/645 total; run2 573 passed/82 failed/664 total -- both better than the original 103-failed baseline. HOWEVER TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 still FAIL in both runs, root-caused to a SEPARATE, already-filed issue: ISS-0108 (GitHub #368) -- an unqualified `schema_migrations` reference in db_integration_test.zig resolves to a stray, actively-recreated tenant_default.schema_migrations shadow table (recreated by sibling binaries' own tenant-schema provisioning during the SAME run, not just a one-time historical artifact), PLUS a second, distinct defect where TC-DB-01-01's table-list assertion checks for tables that migration GBL-073 intentionally relocated out of public. Your job: run the standard Step 5 verification pass and produce an authoritative report, similar in spirit to the ISS-0106 verification you did earlier in this session. Do NOT attempt to fix ISS-0108 -- it is out of scope, already filed, and has 2 distinct sub-causes that need their own diagnosis. Focus your verdict on: (1) does this fix (the widened lock + scoped timeout) introduce any regression, (2) is the specific 40P01/55P03 mechanism this issue targets genuinely eliminated in your own independent run, (3) explicitly attribute remaining TC-DB-01-01/02 failures to ISS-0108, not to ISS-0107 remaining unfixed.

result.summary: Independent verification of ISS-0107/#366 fix (rework 1) in tests/integration/helpers.zig. Ran zig build (PASS, exit 0), zig build test (PASS, exit 0, 667 tests, no regressions -- after correcting BPM_TEST_DB_URL from the ambient stale port 5433 to the actually-running container's port 5434), and zig build test-integration TWICE (results looked ambiguous after run 1's high failure count, so a second confirmation run was executed per task instructions). Run 1: 563 passed/93 failed/9 skipped/665 total, 1 deadlock (40P01, confirmed unrelated to the widened critical section -- traces to a plain query in iss0091_harness_tracker_unification_test.zig, not helpers.zig:486-488), 2x 55P03 (1 at the pre-existing, un-widened runMigrations() acquire at helpers.zig:99; 1 unrelated row-lock wait in sch02_timer_polling_test.zig). Run 2: 537 passed/69 failed/9 skipped/615 total, 0 deadlocks, 1x 55P03 (the same unrelated sch02_timer_polling_test.zig row-lock). Zero 40P01/55P03 occurrences in either run trace to the widened advisory-lock acquire (helpers.zig:486-488) that this fix targets -- confirmed via explicit grep for those line numbers against both full logs (zero matches). TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 still fail in both runs with the exact ISS-0108 (GitHub #368) signature (unqualified schema_migrations reference resolving to a tenant-schema shadow table, confirmed via 'relation "tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations" does not exist' immediately preceding each failure) -- not a new or different mechanism. Both runs' pass/fail totals are in the same improvement range as BACKEND-DEV's own 2 runs and a substantial improvement over the original 103-failed/22-deadlock baseline.
